result.strongest_objection: The body's load-bearing measurement claims contradict the doc's own verification log. §8 R2 says the race gate is exposed because "three packages probe (V19)", but V19's observed column names exactly two probe-bearing test packages (cmd/ailang-worldd and host/broker, 5 files each). §1 row 3(c) and §2 assert "80 runs of 8 concurrent profiles" behind the 216.9 ms worst cross-profile margin, but V16/V17 log ZZ_XP_ITERS=10 across 4 shim/load cells — 40 sessions, not 80, with no row accounting for the other 40. In a doc whose headline Item-3 verdict ("REFUTED in-process at HEAD, by measurement, not by enforcement") and whose deliberate refusal to build a cross-profile barrier (§8 R1) rest entirely on measurement-not-enforcement, an evidence base that overstates N by 2× and miscounts the probing packages fails premise verification: the barrier-abstention decision is only as credible as these numbers, and as written they cannot be reproduced from the artifacts cited.
result.catch: Reconcile three specific log/body mismatches before this proceeds: (1) §1(c)/§2 "80 runs of 8 profiles" vs V16/V17 logged ITERS=10 × 2 shims × {idle,load} = 40 sessions — either attach the missing 40 as V16b/V17b artifacts or restate the statistic over 40 sessions; (2) §8 R2 "three packages probe" vs V19's two; (3) §3.1's T10 spec leaves `listenWindow` undefined — if the executor implements it as a test-side literal instead of aliasing `execProbeListenMS`, T10's ceiling stops deriving from code, re-creating the exact literal-drift class P1/K7 exist to kill (the doc's relegated T6 is the only backstop, and the doc explicitly refuses to rely on it). Also resolve §3.3's self-contradictory heading "before merge (non-blocking)": its own decision rule says a missing Linux run leaves the cell UNMEASURED without blocking, so one of the two phrases is false.
